message.content: {"note_claim": "A state Real ID is a state-issued identity card, not an immigration document.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "The federal REAL ID Act of 2005 establishes minimum standards for state-issued driver\u2019s licenses and identification cards that will be accepted as identification for certain official federal purposes.", "reason": "The page describes REAL ID as a state-issued license/ID card for identification purposes, consistent with the note, but it does not address the INA carry requirement or that citizens need not carry immigration documents."}

parsed.note_claim: A state Real ID is a state-issued identity card, not an immigration document.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: The federal REAL ID Act of 2005 establishes minimum standards for state-issued driver’s licenses and identification cards that will be accepted as identification for certain official federal purposes.
parsed.reason: The page describes REAL ID as a state-issued license/ID card for identification purposes, consistent with the note, but it does not address the INA carry requirement or that citizens need not carry immigration documents.
